camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeRecordStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2019-07-04' --Rr www --DomainType PUBLIC --DomainName 'exmaple.com' --Lang en --EndDate '2019-07-04'
description_en: Queries real-time data about DNS requests for a specified subdomain
description_zh: 查询指定子域名请求量的实时数据
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-record-statistics --lang en --start-date 2019-07-04 --end-date 2019-07-04 --domain-name exmaple.com --rr www --domain-type PUBLIC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecordStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The start date must be within the last 90 days.

If the time range of the query is 7 days or less, data is returned by the hour.

If the time range of the query is more than 7 days, data is returned by the day
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90`。

若查询时间小于等于7天，按照`维度：小时`返回数据，即：`StartDate <= Now - 7`。

若查询时间大于7天，按照`维度：天`返回数据，即：`StartDate > Now - 7`
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current date
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

默认为查询当天的时间
parameters.name: end_date

主域名名称。域名名称。<props="china">可通过调取DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>

parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The host record. For example, to resolve www.example.com, set this parameter to www
parameters.help_zh: 指主机记录，如果要解析www.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写www
parameters.name: rr

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC (default): authoritative domain name

CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

PUBLIC：权威域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
